A tavern tucked away in the centre

Giagkini is a small cookhouse and tavern in the centre of Limassol, near Saripolou Square. Inside, red and green walls, wooden floors and old cupboards; at the back, a courtyard with trees and climbing plants. Guests on Google call it a hidden gem, where many locals eat.

The menu is short: meat from the charcoal grill and meze, which you put together yourself and share at the table. Guests praise the friendly service, the music and the fair prices. The place is small, so it is best to reserve.

What guests say

Four of 214 Google reviews, 4.7 stars on average.

“Traditional Cypriot food in a beautiful yard with lots of trees. Very easy going and relaxing. Very good portions and value for money. The pork in wine was my fave :)”
Google review
“Amazing meat place! A traditional “koutouki” with a really nice wine list, frozen beers and maybe some of the best seftalies and souvlaki I have ever had! It’s a small place, so a reservation is recommended. Don’t miss it!”
Google review
“Had a really lovely meal here, I love the spicy sausage, halloumi, sieftalia and grilled aubergine!”
Google review
“Secret gem in the busy area of Saripolou. Food is excellent, people operating the place are friendly and welcoming. Atmosphere takes you back to an actual tavern with small plates, nice wine and music. Highly recommended for laid back people.”
